Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: kv-cache-proxy error rate spike detected (5xx > 8% over 5m) — affected route: /v1/generate — Pager sent to #eng-oncall and oncall rotation.

Maya G: taking this one for my shift handoff — paging worked, I acked in PagerDuty. quick context: we saw a similar transient yesterday at 02:10 UTC, likely proxy-to-kv connection churn.

Sasha (oncall): ack. I'm coming up as primary for the next hour (handoff in 2m). who will be comms? need someone to own customer updates if this goes > 30m.

Maya G: I'll stay as secondary for 30m while you settle in. Kevin, can you take comms with CS/Support? Lia, can you be backup for infra ops if we need a deeper restart?

Kevin R: I can do comms. I'll draft an update to the affected customers and post to #customer-impact after we confirm mitigation steps. suggested message: "We're investigating increased 5xx errors for the embeddings/generation endpoints; mitigation in progress." I'll wait to push until Sasha confirms plan.

Sasha (oncall): plan: 1) confirm proxy health, 2) fail traffic to s-cluster-b if proxy unstable, 3) enable fallback model (quantized) for heavy routes to reduce KV load. Running quick checks now. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-failover (see steps 2-4).

Maya G: extra note — batching config was recently increased in prod for throughput. if we failover, drop batch_size to 8 to reduce concurrent KV sessions. config path: `configs/prod/inference/batching.yaml` (look for `max_batch_size`).

Sasha (oncall): checking proxy pods: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=kv-proxy` shows 2/3 ready on cluster-a, restarts: `RESTARTS 4` in last 15m. tailing logs:
```
[2025-05-03T21:01:12Z] ERROR kafka_conn: connection reset by peer
[2025-05-03T21:02:01Z] WARN  kvproxy: slow response 480ms
[2025-05-03T21:02:45Z] ERROR kvproxy: upstream 502 on GET /kv/lookup
```

Sasha (oncall): mitigation step 1 executed: cordon node with repeated restarts, scaling kv-proxy replica set to 4 on cluster-b: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/kv-proxy --replicas=4` — that bumped capacity. also flipped route to s-cluster-b for 10% traffic via the router weight experiment. monitoring error rate.

Kevin R: started drafting customer note: "We have routed a portion of traffic away from an impacted cluster and are monitoring error rates. Some users may see higher latencies briefly. We'll update in 15 minutes or sooner." Approving to post when you confirm 10% route shift is stable. :+1:

Lia T: FYI, we have a coverage gap 03:00-07:00 UTC tomorrow (oncall schedule shows Oliver on PTO). if this escalates into full outage overnight we won't have our normal A-team. recommend we flag for support-eng leadership if projected > 2 hours.

Sasha (oncall): noted. current error rate dropped to 2.1% after scale+reroute. rolling out fallback model for /v1/generate heavy route now: `infra deploy --model fallback-v2 --route /v1/generate --weight 30` — expecting lower KV pressure.

Maya G: thanks. handoff summary for the record: primary now Sasha (oncall), secondary Maya G, comms Kevin R, infra backup Lia T. runbook referenced and actions taken: scaled kv-proxy, partial reroute to cluster-b, fallback model enabled, batch size recommendation saved.

Sasha (oncall): I'll keep this thread as single source of truth. if anything changes ping @Kevin R for customer updates and @Lia T for infra escalations. I'll update #eng-oncall in 15m with final status. :white_check_mark:

Kevin R: posted initial customer-facing update to #customer-impact and escalated to CS lead. will post follow-ups as Sasha updates.

Incident Bot: Incident status changed to "observing" — error rate back under threshold. No active pages for this thread.

Maya G: thanks team — I'm dropping out of primary but remain reachable for 20m. Sasha, you drive the post-mortem if we see any regression.

Sasha (oncall): Roger. I'll create a follow-up postmortem draft and include the runbook deviations (batching bump + immediate reroute). recording owners: remediation: Sasha, comms: Kevin, postmortem: Sasha + Maya.

Lia T: noted. added a brief note to the runbook about the scheduling gap tomorrow.

Kevin R: marking comms closed for now, will reopen if customers ask for more detail.

Sasha (oncall): closing thread for now — will reopen if error resurfaces. thanks all. :v:
